The error is a FileNotFoundException for /app/data/orders.csv raised in the OrderRepository constructor, which may be a missing deploy file (hand-off to ops) or a code fault.

arguments.message:
Run id: eval-get-order-1001-20261127-053832-triage-1. Please investigate this error from the order-service (repository demos/louis-agent/samples/order-service).

Error: {"id": "5c1e9a0f2b77", "timestamp": "2026-11-24T12:16:20.0300353+00:00", "service": "order-service", "method": "get-order", "arguments": "1001", "exception_type": "System.IO.FileNotFoundException", "message": "Could not find file '/app/data/orders.csv'.", "stack_trace": "   at System.IO.FileSystem.OpenHandle(String fullPath)\n   at System.IO.File.ReadLines(String path)\n   at OrderService.OrderRepository..ctor(String csvPath) in src/OrderService/Orders.cs:line 22\n   at Program.<Main>$(String[] args) in src/OrderService/Program.cs:line 8"}

Runbook for get-order: GET /orders/{id} returns a one-line summary (id, customer, item count, first SKU) from data/orders.csv, which the deploy puts beside the service. Expected (no action): OrderService.OrderNotFoundException. Decisions table:
- a crash in this method's code, cause certain: a lookup must never crash on an order that exists, including one with no items -> auto-fix (coder)
- the data file data/orders.csv missing or unreadable, or where it is deployed -> hand-off (ops)
- a fix not confirmed, or cause not certain -> person (orders)
Expected behaviour: every order in the data returns its summary; an order without items says 0 items and no first SKU; unknown ids still throw OrderNotFoundException.

Please find where the cause is, what it is in one sentence, whose area it is (code, data, hosting, third-party, unknown) and how sure you are (low, medium, high). Report with ReportInvestigation. Do not change code.
